description: List an agent's recent config-change audit trail (change_type, change_source, old/new value, timestamp) — the same change log the owner hears when they call their line and ask what changed. Every change KaiCalls makes to an agent (via update_agent_config, configure_agent_business_rules, the owner's call-in line, or the dashboard) is logged here. Rows carry no version number; to undo a change, pick a version from list_config_versions and use rollback_config.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to fetch change history for.

name: get_change_history
title: Get Agent Change History
